biothings.name: KLF transcription factor 5
biothings.summary: This gene encodes a member of the Kruppel-like factor subfamily of zinc finger proteins. The encoded protein is a transcriptional activator that binds directly to a specific recognition motif in the promoters of target genes. This protein acts downstream of multiple different signaling pathways and is regulated by post-translational modification. It may participate in both promoting and suppressing cell proliferation. Expression of this gene may be changed in a variety of different cancers and in cardiovascular disease. Alternative splicing results in multiple transcript variants. [provided by RefSeq, Nov 2013].

biothings.name: CFTR -35 kb upstream enhancer
biothings.summary: This genomic region represents a DNase I hypersensitive site, DHS-35kb, that corresponds to an enhancer of the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene, which is located approximately 35 kb downstream. This enhancer functions in cells of the bronchial airways and it shows cooperative activity with the -44 kb, -3.4 kb and intron 23 CFTR enhancers. It is stimulated by binding of interferon regulatory factors 1 and 2, and is associated with the NF-Y and BAF155 transcription factors, and also with KLF5 and Ets homologous factor (EHF), which repress airway expression of CFTR. Looping interactions have been observed between this region and the CFTR promoter. [provided by RefSeq, Nov 2018]
